response.sql: WITH counts_per_obs AS (SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) as count FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), totals AS (SELECT SUM(count) as total FROM counts_per_obs), shares AS (SELECT c.count, CAST(c.count AS REAL) / t.total as share FROM counts_per_obs c CROSS JOIN totals t), avg_info AS (SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share FROM shares), above_avg AS (SELECT s.count, s.share, a.avg_share FROM shares s CROSS JOIN avg_info a WHERE s.share > a.avg_share) SELECT SUM(count) as total_telescopes, AVG(share) as average_share, AVG(share - avg_share) as average_excess FROM above_avg
